offering: Decide whether an exact proposed wheel-only native dependency lock satisfies declared project roots, requested extras and all active wheel metadata constraints, with inspectable conflict witnesses and complete retained logs.
observed_need: Existing Alpha native dependency maintenance; internal project need. Commercial demand, buyer acceptance and actual customer savings are unobserved.
acceptance_scope: Exact native CPython3.12.14/Linux marker environment and metadata consistency only. No install, application behavior, security, live identity, runtime adoption, release or transaction qualification.

preparation.selection: All15 lexicographically ordered pairwise combinations of six preserved predecessor pin substitutions, without inspecting new outcomes or replacing unsuccessful tuples.
preparation.freshness: Unseen combined questions over historical public release artifacts. Correlated compositions, not15 independent ecosystems, prospective releases or customer orders.
preparation.development_case: Unchanged inherited lock; repeat engineering check, not fresh outcome.

root_stresses.change: Change root constraint from cryptography>=50.0.1,<51 to>=51,<52 while preserving baseline lock; designed negative requirement stress.
Remove selected project chain extra while preserving all lock rows; changed scope, not improvement of original requirement.
Change project Python range from>=3.11,<3.14 to>=3.13,<3.14; designed incompatible-current-environment stress.

comparison_contract.ABC: Same source-bound native Workbench run, same ordinary pip/hash caches, wheels, environment, independent metadata verifier and common report/ZIP packaging. Selector policy/relationships/provenance overhead alone differ.
comparison_contract.D: Stronger conventional direct incumbent with identical metadata acceptance and report packaging, without native history. Native history is an internal integration constraint; no customer price or utility premium is assumed.
comparison_contract.cache_policy: No hidden producer cache. Caller may reuse unchanged results under identical per-arm policies. Hash and pip caches are available to all arms.
comparison_contract.deduplication: src.acceptance.mission_key uses active lock requirements/hashes, selected wheels, declared project roots/extras/Python range and environment. It excludes job alias/path, prose, timings and comment-only source changes.
comparison_contract.fresh_after_change: A substantive dependency, selected root requirement or environment change creates a different mission key and requires fresh evaluation.
comparison_contract.no_adaptive_repair: No pipeline or acceptance changes after confirmation freeze; failure or incomplete output retained. Any corrected edition must be separately registered.

acceptance.independence: Separate deterministic implementation re-parses actual wheel METADATA/WHEEL records, activates markers and recursive extras, checks all exact selected requirements and reconciles raw pip report. Same-session provenance is not organizational or hostile-recorder independence.
acceptance.native_custody: production/workbench.mjs remains byte-identical; its source and native closure checks execute. Native pack remains HOLD and UNAUTHENTICATED_HISTORICAL_IMPORT with empty active proof/authority.
common_outcomes: Unaccepted INCOMPLETE/refusal with retained failure evidence
acceptance.composition: Each joint lock is independently resolved and metadata-verified. Individual predecessor results never authorize combined outcome.
